cases.title: Viewer can open the Monthly Summary
preconditions: User viewer.one has the Viewer role

ac_quotes.text: A Viewer can open the Monthly Summary report only; other reports do not appear in the Viewer's report list.

cases.title: Viewer's report list hides every other report
preconditions: User viewer.one has the Viewer role
cases.expected: The list shows only Monthly Summary; Transaction Detail and Payroll are not listed.

ac_quotes.text: A Viewer can open the Monthly Summary report only; other reports do not appear in the Viewer's report list.

cases.title: Analyst can open Monthly Summary and Transaction Detail
preconditions: User analyst.one has the Analyst role
steps: Go back and open Transaction Detail

ac_quotes.text: An Analyst can open the Monthly Summary and Transaction Detail reports.

cases.title: Analyst opening the Payroll URL is refused
preconditions: User analyst.one has the Analyst role
The Payroll report URL is known
steps: Paste the Payroll report URL into the address bar
cases.expected: The server returns HTTP 403 and the page shows "You don't have access to this report".

ac_quotes.text: An Analyst can open the Monthly Summary and Transaction Detail reports.
Opening a report's URL directly without permission returns HTTP 403 and shows the message "You don't have access to this report".

cases.title: Finance Manager can open every report, including Payroll
preconditions: User fm.one has the Finance Manager role
steps: Open each report in the list in turn
cases.expected: Monthly Summary, Transaction Detail and Payroll all open.

ac_quotes.text: A Finance Manager can open every report, including Payroll.

cases.title: Viewer typing the Transaction Detail URL gets an access-denied page
preconditions: User viewer.one has the Viewer role
steps: Type the Transaction Detail report URL directly
cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned with the message "You don't have access to this report", and no report data is shown.

ac_quotes.text: Opening a report's URL directly without permission returns HTTP 403 and shows the message "You don't have access to this report".

cases.title: Permitted user opening a report URL directly sees the report
preconditions: User analyst.one has the Analyst role
steps: Type the Transaction Detail report URL directly
cases.expected: The Transaction Detail report opens with no access-denied message.

ac_quotes.text: An Analyst can open the Monthly Summary and Transaction Detail reports.
Opening a report's URL directly without permission returns HTTP 403 and shows the message "You don't have access to this report".

cases.title: Role change applies at the next sign-in
preconditions: User viewer.two has the Viewer role and is signed out
steps: As an administrator, change viewer.two to Analyst
cases.expected: Transaction Detail now appears in the list and opens.

ac_quotes.text: A role change takes effect at the user's next sign-in; a session that is already open keeps the old permissions until then.

cases.title: Open session keeps the old permissions after a role change
preconditions: User viewer.two has the Viewer role and is signed in
steps: As an administrator, change viewer.two to Analyst
In the user's open session, refresh Reports
cases.expected: The list still shows only Monthly Summary until the user signs in again.

ac_quotes.text: A role change takes effect at the user's next sign-in; a session that is already open keeps the old permissions until then.

cases.title: Payroll shows the viewer's email as a watermark on every page
preconditions: User fm.one (fm.one@example.com) has the Finance Manager role
cases.expected: Each page shows fm.one@example.com as a watermark.

ac_quotes.text: The Payroll report shows the viewer's email address as a watermark on every page.

cases.title: Denied attempt is written to the audit log
preconditions: User viewer.one has the Viewer role
steps: Sign in as viewer.one and type the Payroll report URL directly
As an administrator, open the audit log
cases.expected: A new entry shows viewer.one's user id, the Payroll report id and the time of the attempt.

ac_quotes.text: Each denied access attempt is written to the audit log with the user id, report id and timestamp.

cases.title: Allowed access does not create a denied-access entry
preconditions: User analyst.one has the Analyst role
steps: Sign in as analyst.one and open Transaction Detail
As an administrator, open the audit log
cases.expected: No denied-access entry exists for analyst.one.

ac_quotes.text: Each denied access attempt is written to the audit log with the user id, report id and timestamp.
